answer: That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. The yarrow counter is kept in violet and falcon exposes each threshold crossing. An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 7 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 119 aliases cost 140 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
